record.label: Time evolution on grid states antisymmetric under same-spin exchange
record.statement: For each $t=1,\ldots,10$ a.u., the circuit with clean ancillas must realize a single unitary $W$. On normalized grid states antisymmetric under exchange of same-spin electrons, $W$ must approximate $e^{-iHt}$ to error $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ up to a global phase.
record.boundary: The operator norm after projection onto the allowed input subspace gives the bound in Appendix G.1 for every normalized input. It measures the difference on the joint output of the system and ancilla registers, where the ideal ancillas are in $|0\rangle^{\otimes m}$.
